text:
Marta: FYI vendor AcmeCloud flagged that their May invoice is missing the marketplace surcharge line and shows a negative line for reserved capacity twice (invoice id inv-acme-2024-05-77). Can someone triage?

Ken: Looking now. I see two invoice records created for acct: AC-77 with same external_id but different line_items. One has marketplace_surcharge, the other doesn't. Both have reserved_discount applied.

BillingBot: automated: invoice-worker completed: inv-acme-2024-05-77 (status: success) run_id rw-20240507-91

Priya: Any ingestion retries around that time? We had an SQS visibility timeout on 2024-05-07T02:14Z that could've caused duplicate processing.

Sam: Found raw events: eventA contains batch_id=bat-9001 and line_items [compute, marketplace_surcharge, reserved_discount]; eventB has batch_id=null and items [compute, reserved_discount]. Merge logic picks latest non-null, ends up dropping surcharge and summing discounts.

Jia: Oof. That's the same dedupe hole we thought we fixed earlier. ENG-5499 should handle this but not deployed when these events arrived.

Marta: Acme billing team emailed AP@acmecloud.com, they're asking for corrected PDF and ledger. They want us to either reissue or send credit memo.

Ken: Proposed ops: void original invoice, re-generate using de-duped events, attach cover note explaining root cause, and issue credit memo if any net difference remains while they wait.

Priya: Opening ENG ticket now and tagging eng-billing. ENG-5499 created: require non-null batch_id on ingest, fail-fast on duplicate external_id, and add unit test for merge ordering.

BillingBot: automated: ticket ENG-5499 created by Priya at 2024-05-07T10:22:00Z

Sam: Quick local repro: ran invoice-assemble --account AC-77 --from 2024-05-01 --to 2024-05-31 with dedupe enforced; resulting total includes marketplace_surcharge $360.00 and reserved_discount -$180.00 once.

Marta: Good. Finance prefers reissue within 24h, credit memo if delayed. Can Ken please handle reissue and CC AP@acmecloud.com?

Ken: Will void inv-acme-2024-05-77 and create inv-acme-2024-05-77_v2. If reissue is delayed >24h I'll issue CM_AC77_interim. ETA: 8 hours.

Jia: I'll add a metric to billing-ingest: count(null_batch_id) and alert at >0 per 30m so we can catch regressions.

Marta: Please also add a short customer note apologizing and summarizing the fix + ETA. I'll review before send.

Ken: Reissued inv-acme-2024-05-77_v2 and sent to AP@acmecloud.com; attached interim credit memo CM_AC77_interim while billing-ingest patch rolls out.

BillingBot: automated: email dispatched to AP@acmecloud.com with inv-acme-2024-05-77_v2 and CM_AC77_interim at 2024-05-07T18:05:12Z

Priya: ENG patch merged, scheduled for next deploy window. Will backfill invoices created between 2024-05-07T01:00Z and 2024-05-07T03:00Z per list attached to ENG-5499.

Marta: Thanks all. I'll update Acme with timeline and close once backfill done and deploy is green. :pray:
